verses.text: I must keep on boasting. It does not help, but I will go on to tell about visions and things the Lord has shown me.
I know a man who belongs to Christ. Fourteen years ago he was taken up to the third heaven. I do not know if he was in his body or out of it. Only God knows.
And I know that this man was taken up, whether in his body or out of it I do not know. God knows.
He was taken up to Paradise. There he heard things too wonderful to tell, things no person is allowed to speak.
I will boast about a man like that, but I will not boast about myself, except about my weaknesses.
Even if I wanted to boast, I would not be a fool, because I would be telling the truth. But I hold back, so that no one will think more of me than what they see me do or hear me say.
God showed me many great things. So to keep me from becoming proud, I was given a thorn in my body. It is a messenger from Satan that hurts me and keeps me from becoming proud.
Three times I begged the Lord to take it away from me.
But he said to me, "My grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak." So I will gladly boast all the more about my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ can rest on me.
That is why, for Christ's sake, I am glad in weaknesses, insults, hard times, attacks and troubles. When I am weak, then I am strong.
I have made a fool of myself, but you made me do it. You should have been praising me. Even though I am nothing, I am not in any way less than those "super apostles."
When I was with you, I patiently did the things that show a true apostle: signs, wonders and mighty works.
How were you treated worse than the other churches? Only in that I never made myself a load for you. Forgive me for this wrong!

Now I am ready to visit you for the third time, and I will not be a load for you. I do not want what you own. I want you. Children should not have to save up for their parents. Parents should save up for their children.
I will very gladly spend everything I have for you, and even spend myself. If I love you more, will you love me less?
Well then, I was not a load for you. But some say I was cunning and caught you with a trick.
Did I cheat you through any of the men I sent to you?
I asked Titus to visit you, and I sent the brother with him. Titus did not cheat you, did he? Did we not act in the same spirit and walk in the same way?
Have you been thinking all this time that we are defending ourselves to you? No, we speak in front of God, as people who belong to Christ. Dear friends, everything we do is to build you up.

I am afraid that when I come, I may not find you as I want you to be, and you may not find me as you want me to be. I am afraid I may find fighting, jealousy, angry tempers, people taking sides, slander, gossip, pride and disorder.

I am afraid that when I come again, my God will make me feel small in front of you. I may have to cry over many who have sinned before and have not turned away from their dirty ways, their sexual sins and their wild living.
